purpose: The four-panel instrument gallery of Figure 12 (section 9): v1 dashboard, v2 cockpit, genome chooser, 10 kW winner cartography. One pass, one commit.
head: ecc6fc6f7b11c9fb055c73c75a389580aa4f4a02
dataset_note: Two panels read no dataset: v1 and v2 render the 10 kW canonical system from the tree (params_10kw(), settled at V = 11 m/s). Two read campaign files at the pin and print no value from either. The chooser loads the three telemetry CSVs named under chooser_inputs (the set the renderer's own glob selects in scripts/results, 3 x 928 = 2784 rows) and its cards carry identity and decoded geometry only, because the --smoke path sets card_text style=:identity, which drops P_mean, FoS, fitness and status. The cartography decodes its ring stack from elite_archive.csv and its title carries the design tag and geometry descriptors only. No panel in the four prints a campaign result, and no value elsewhere in the report is taken from any capture.
provenance_note: Each capture names its invocation under `flags`, because two of the four do not print their shipped frame under the renderer's defaults. The chooser's identity-only cards come from the --smoke path, and the cartography's geometry title is set by KTD_WINNER_TITLE=geometry; a reader holding the commit, the renderer and the input hashes still needs those flags to rebuild the frame. Figure 11's captures directory is tracked from fa91a8e, so both figures' kits now carry a renderer in the tree.

print.row_2: chooser + cartography, flush from 0.00 mm; the 1.82 mm the chooser leaves inside its cell reads as the row's trailing gutter
